metadata.name: entry
metadata.description: launch entry: a kanban board built ONLY from general formulas — a cels() tasks sheet + a winapp board (LET/LAMBDA + FILTER/MAP/INDEX/CONCAT) wired to the drag.* primitive. Dragging a card FILTERs it into its new column reactively (a drop setValues the task's status cel).

cels.f: =segment(cels('tasks', 6, 3, at('A1', 1), at('B1', 'Email Bob'), at('C1', 'To Do'), at('A2', 2), at('B2', 'Write spec'), at('C2', 'Doing'), at('A3', 3), at('B3', 'Fix bug'), at('C3', 'To Do'), at('A4', 4), at('B4', 'Ship release'), at('C4', 'Done'), at('A5', 5), at('B5', 'Plan sprint'), at('C5', 'Doing'), at('A6', 6), at('B6', 'Review PR'), at('C6', 'To Do')), wopen('kanban', '📋 Kanban', "=LET(cardOf, LAMBDA(id, dom('div.kcard', attr('draggable', 'true'), on('dragstart', 'drag.grab', CONCAT('tasks.C', id)), INDEX(tasks!B1:B6, id))), colOf, LAMBDA(name, dom('div.kcol', attr('data-col', name), on('dragover', 'drag.over'), on('drop', 'drag.drop', name), dom('h3', name), MAP(FILTER(tasks!A1:A6, LAMBDA(id, INDEX(tasks!C1:C6, id) = name)), cardOf))), dom('div.kboard', dom('style', '.kboard{display:flex;gap:.6rem;padding:.5rem;align-items:flex-start;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.kcol{flex:1;min-width:0;background:#8881;border:1px solid #8883;border-radius:.5rem;padding:.4rem;min-height:160px}.kcol h3{margin:.1rem 0 .5rem;font:700 .78rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#888;text-align:center}.kcard{background:Canvas;border:1px solid #8884;border-radius:.4rem;padding:.4rem .55rem;margin:.35rem 0;cursor:grab;font:600 .76rem ui-monospace,monospace;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0003;user-select:none}.kcard:active{cursor:grabbing}'), colOf('To Do'), colOf('Doing'), colOf('Done')))"))

manifests.name: kanbanapp
manifests.description: a kanban board, as an installable origin-application (cels + drag.* primitive)
